item.title: Installation and updates
item.description:
Installation and updates #

Start with an empty data directory, then configure the bot, storage, and users in the web console.

Binary deployment #

Download and extract a release for your platform:

chmod +x saveany-bot
./saveany-bot

The default data directory is data/ under the current working directory. The web UI listens on 127.0.0.1:28080 by default. At startup it prints a direct URL with an access token:

Web UI available at http://127.0.0.1:28080/?token=...

Open that URL; the token creates an authenticated session. Unless an access token is set under Settings → Web, a new token is generated on every start.

item.title: Migrate from v0
item.description:
Migrate from v0 #

v1 stores configuration in a local SQLite database. On first startup, it imports a legacy v0 config.toml once, then all settings are managed from the web console.

v1 does not migrate Telegram sessions. The v0 session.db and usersession.db files were created by gotgproto and are no longer read. Migration imports the legacy configuration; v1 uses a new database. The bot signs in again with the configured token, and an enabled Userbot must sign in again from the web console. Back up all existing files before upgrading.
